artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathfrak{A}$ be a quasi-Banach operator ideal (in the sense of Pietsch: a class of bounded linear operators between arbitrary Banach spaces, closed under composition with bounded operators on either side, containing the finite-rank operators, and equipped with a complete quasi-norm). For a quasi-Banach (shift-monotone) sequence ideal $\mathfrak{x}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ — that is, a linear subspace of the space of scalar sequences indexed by $\mathbb{N}_0 = \{0,1,2,\dots\}$ that is invariant under the forward and backward shift operators, complete in a given quasi-norm, and such that the quasi-norm is monotone with respect to shifts — one defines the approximation-type operator ideal $\mathfrak{A}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{\mathfrak{x}}$ as the class of operators $T : X \to Y$ between Banach spaces for which the sequence of approximation numbers (or, more generally, the sequence of $\mathfrak{A}$-approximation numbers) $\bigl(a_n^{\mathfrak{A}}(T)\bigr)_{n\in\mathbb{N}_0}$, defined by
$$a_n^{\mathfrak{A}}(T) = \inf\{\|T-L\|_{\mathfrak{A}} : L\in\mathfrak{A}(X,Y),\ \operatorname{rank}(L)\le n\},$$
belongs to $\mathfrak{x}(\mathbb{N}_0)$, equipped with the natural induced quasi-norm.

Prove that, for every quasi-Banach operator ideal $\mathfrak{A}$ and every pair of quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideals $\mathfrak{x}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ and $\mathfrak{y}(\mathbb{N}_0)$, there exists a quasi-Banach shift-monotone sequence ideal $\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ such that the iterated APP-construction collapses to a single step:
$$\bigl(\mathfrak{A}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{\mathfrak{x}}\bigr)^{\mathrm{APP}}_{\mathfrak{y}} \;=\; \mathfrak{A}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{\mathfrak{z}}.$$
Equivalently, identify (and describe explicitly) such a sequence ideal $\mathfrak{z}(\mathbb{N}_0)$ in terms of $\mathfrak{x}$ and $\mathfrak{y}$, with equality of the associated quasi-norms up to equivalence.
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed as an explicit open problem in Pietsch's list of open problems on traces of operator ideals over Banach spaces. Searches for a published resolution of the reiteration identity $(\mathfrak{A}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{\mathfrak{x}})^{\mathrm{APP}}_{\mathfrak{y}} = \mathfrak{A}^{\mathrm{APP}}_{\mathfrak{z}}$ for general quasi-Banach operator ideals and shift-monotone sequence ideals did not yield a solution; related work treats approximation spaces and reiteration in restricted (e.g., Hilbert space, or specific sequence-ideal) settings but does not establish the general Banach-space version. Status appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Modern Applications of s-numbers and Operator Ideals (Oberwolfach Report)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Pietsch's program of associating operator ideals to shift-monotone sequence ideals and listing open problems on traces and approximation-type ideals.
status_evidence.claim: The reiteration question for APP-type constructions on Banach-space operator ideals fits within Pietsch's program of open problems and has not been resolved in the cited literature.

status_evidence.title: Traces on operator ideals and related linear forms on sequence ideals (part III)
status_evidence.snippet: Develops correspondence between traces on operator ideals and linear forms on shift-monotone sequence ideals without resolving the general APP reiteration identity.
status_evidence.claim: Related developments address traces and sequence ideals but do not establish the iterated APP collapse for arbitrary quasi-Banach operator ideals.
